source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check BMC ROM size
1. Get the latest BMC firmware packet.
2. Zip the packet , and check if the  ROM Size if mapped the release note.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check with release note , it should have record the BMC fw size.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands:
# agent host: BMC firmware/controller info (lanplus)
ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" mc info 2>&1
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return ipmitool mc info firmware details; operator compares the .bin image size to the release-note recorded BMC FW size.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; correctly requests package/release note and uses mc info for identity, but that command does not measure image size or flash capacity and human comparison does not limit automation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; distinguishes package payload, archive and physical capacity and enforces read-only BMC access.
historical_reviews.workflow_logic: Historically classifies PARTIAL because an operator provides the .bin; V3.1 treats artifact supply as readiness, not a manual core step.
historical_reviews.round_02: PARTIAL; returns controller identity for an operator comparison but does not resolve size semantics.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: Confirms mc info is identity evidence only and no update/reset/SEL clear is permitted.

original_test_intent: Verify the owner-approved BMC firmware artifact's specified size against the matching vendor release note and, if separately required, distinguish raw BMC image size from package archive size and physical BMC flash capacity for the exact controller/platform.
original_method: Obtain the exact BMC firmware package and release note, preserve hashes, inspect archive members in isolation, measure the owner-selected artifact in exact bytes/units and compare it with the named release-note field; use read-only OOB identity/capacity data only as separate correlated evidence.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the BMC artifact, release note and size semantics and later issues the verdict. Hashing, safe archive inspection, controller identity collection and numeric comparison are automatable; no physical action or BMC write/reset is required.
required_inputs: Exact BMC/controller, board/SKU and approved target firmware version—not unbounded 'latest'
BMC package, hash and matching release note
Owner correction of whether 'Zip the packet' means compress, extract/unzip or inspect the archive
Definition of ROM Size: archive, payload, declared region or physical flash capacity
Release-note field/units/tolerance and protected read-only IPMI/Redfish credentials if needed
safety_requirements: Do not flash, reset, configure or clear SEL; this is a read-only artifact/identity comparison.
Inspect untrusted packages in an isolated non-system path and never execute bundled update tools.
Protect credentials and do not treat mc info firmware version as byte-size or capacity evidence.
Stop on package/controller/SKU/hash mismatch, ambiguous member/units or access anomaly; do not guess or auto-remediate.
agent_execution_scope: Validate BMC/package/release-note identities and hashes and inventory archive contents safely.
Measure the owner-selected image/member in exact bytes, compare with the release-note field and report unit conversion explicitly.
Collect read-only controller identity/health and any separately approved capacity evidence, verify no state change and keep Tool Result separate from engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve zip/image/ROM-capacity semantics and approve the exact package/member and release-note field.
Approve the target BMC identity and any read-only OOB access/capacity method.
Review the comparison and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool mc info is relevant for controller/firmware identity but does not measure .bin bytes or physical flash capacity. It must be supporting evidence, not the acceptance measurement.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use checksum and safe archive metadata/extraction tools for the approved package, then compare exact member bytes to the named release-note field; retain mc info or approved Redfish only for target identity/health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The literal 'latest', 'Zip the packet', BMC ROM Size, release-note mapping and 5/0-minute fields are preserved; execution pins an exact approved version.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a signed manifest for controller/board, BMC version, package/member hashes, archive/raw image sizes, declared regions and release-note field/units; record physical flash capacity separately if requested.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BMC/board/SKU and firmware package in the manifest.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record package/release-note revision, BMC firmware and artifact-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Use supplied BMC release note and vendor packaging/flash documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Separates non-equivalent size concepts and makes mc info identity-only while preserving read-only OOB checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; selected artifact metrics and optional capacity are explicitly separated.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Owner semantic correction and exact package/release-note field.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Compressed package size is not a firmware payload or flash capacity, and multi-region BMC images may include headers/padding.

project_override_considerations: A project selects the exact BMC artifact and intended size metric(s). Missing artifacts are readiness gates, not PARTIAL/BLOCKED; project convention does not erase the master source ambiguity.
expected_evidence: Owner decision for zip/extract and archive/image/capacity semantics
Safe archive listing, selected member path/hash and exact byte/unit measurements
Release-note comparison, read-only BMC identity/health, no-write proof, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item says BMC ROM Size, step 2 says to 'Zip the packet,' and the criterion cites BMC firmware size in the release note. Archive size, raw image size and physical flash capacity are non-equivalent, so owner correction is required.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The safe artifact-comparison objective is clear despite the metric conflict. Once the artifact and intended field are selected, the complete core is automatable; the case is not permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains mc info as identity evidence but rejects operator comparison as a capability limit and rejects it as size proof.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains artifact distinctions, credential and no-write safeguards while reclassifying PARTIAL to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Records the size conflation as SOURCE_CONFLICT and defines a reproducible package-to-release-note comparison.

review_improvement: Prevents misuse of controller version output as size evidence, avoids BMC state changes and correctly classifies a fully electronic artifact comparison.
independent_technical_reasoning: All technical steps are static artifact inspection and read-only OOB queries. Supplying artifacts and selecting the intended metric are readiness/source-resolution inputs, so capability remains FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
